study_protocol.primary_endpoint: complete-case correctness, including independently verified quote, tuple, unit, source and required abstention
selection_rule: Compare complete-case rates on development partition only.
If equal, select lower measured token-cost configuration.
If accuracy differs, report paired family-bootstrap uncertainty; do not claim statistical superiority from a point difference alone.
study_protocol.repair_policy: Up to three explicit development rounds for diagnosed prompt or technical defects; preserve every report and record changes. No adjustment after inspecting test outcomes.
study_protocol.test_policy: Freeze implementation, prompts, parser/scorer versions and chosen configuration before test. Evaluate both predeclared models once on test. Do not use test results to select or tune.
study_protocol.capture_policy: all; original synthetic model output only; no credentials or request headers
study_protocol.interpretation: Controlled synthetic extraction capability and software usability; no scientific, clinical, real-author or natural-document efficacy validation.
study_protocol.prior_round_status: Round1 invalid for model selection: ambiguous unit/value and predicate instructions; preserved as contract diagnostic.
study_protocol.metadata_correction: Canonical identity in v2 was computed after an implicit Windows locale decode. Corrected with explicit UTF-8. Actual model CLI inputs and file-byte hash were already correct; no source data, labels, partitions or endpoint changed.

protocol_history: Original v2 preceded DEV. v2.1 is a canonical-digest metadata amendment during DEV, with identical inputs, endpoints and selection rule; both originals are preserved.
